notes: @sendgrid/client and SENDGRID_API_KEY (sendgrid), @sentry/* and SENTRY_DSN (sentry), stripe and STRIPE_* (stripe), @vercel/* (vercel), posthog-js and NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY (posthog), react-use-intercom and NEXT_PUBLIC_INTERCOM_APP_ID (intercom), NEXT_PUBLIC_ZENDESK_KEY (zendesk widget), TWILIO_VERIFY_SID (twilio SMS verification), NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDFLARE_SITEKEY and CLOUDFLARE_TURNSTILE_SECRET (cloudflare Turnstile). googleapis serves Google Calendar (Workspace), not Google Cloud.
